<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Verify the path by checking for obstacles between steps
# Path: RIGHT DOWN DOWN DOWN DOWN RIGHT RIGHT DOWN RIGHT RIGHT
# Player at (15,15), moves 6 pixels per action

seg = current_frame.segmentation
nodes = seg['nodes']

# Build detailed grid at pixel level
pixel_grid = {}
for n in nodes:
    if n['color'] == 'B' and n['pixels'] > 100:
        continue
    if n['color'] == 'M':
        continue
    boundary = n['boundary']
    min_r = min(p[0] for p in boundary)
    min_c = min(p[1] for p in boundary)
    max_r = max(p[0] for p in boundary)
    max_c = max(p[1] for p in boundary)
    for r in range(min_r, max_r + 1):
        for c in range(min_c, max_c + 1):
            pixel_grid[(r, c)] = n['color']

# Path positions (pixel coords)
path = [(15,15), (15,21), (21,21), (27,21), (33,21), (39,21), (39,27), (39,33), (45,33), (45,39), (45,45)]

# Check each path step and intermediate cells
for i in range(len(path) - 1):
    r1, c1 = path[i]
    r2, c2 = path[i+1]
    # Check cells between start and end
    if r1 == r2:  # horizontal move
        for c in range(min(c1,c2), max(c1,c2) + 1):
            color = pixel_grid.get((r1, c), 'B')
            if color == 'B':
                print(f"WARNING: Black at ({r1},{c}) between step {i} and {i+1}")
    else:  # vertical move
        for r in range(min(r1,r2), max(r1,r2) + 1):
            color = pixel_grid.get((r, c1), 'B')
            if color == 'B':
                print(f"WARNING: Black at ({r},{c1}) between step {i} and {i+1}")
    
    # Check landing position
    landing_color = pixel_grid.get(path[i+1], 'B')
    print(f"Step {i+1}: {path[i]} -> {path[i+1]}, landing on {landing_color}")

# Execute the path
moves = ['RIGHT', 'DOWN', 'DOWN', 'DOWN', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT', 'DOWN', 'RIGHT', 'RIGHT']
print(f"\nExecuting {len(moves)} moves...")
action(moves)
print(f"Result: {last_action_result}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
